_meta.description: Mandate matrix schemas, plus two organisatieRol rows (parties-on-the-case task 3.2) so the Team picker on a case and a task, and the Team facet on both indexes, have something to show on a fresh instance. Without them the field renders an empty picker, which reads exactly like a broken reference rather than an instance that has no teams yet. The e2e seeds its own rows and does not read these.

mandateDecision.title: Mandate Decision
mandateDecision.description: A mandate decision taken by the governing body: a collection of Mandate rows valid from effectiveFrom until expiryDate.

decisionNumber.title: Decision Number
decisionNumber.description: Unique number identifying this mandate decision.

decisionName.title: Decision Name
decisionName.description: Human-readable name of this mandate decision.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current lifecycle status of the mandate decision. The enum VALUES are stored data, not identifiers: renaming them rewrites every existing row and is a separate migration from this property rename.

effectiveFrom.title: Entry Into Force
effectiveFrom.description: Date on which this mandate decision enters into force.

expiryDate.title: Expiry date
expiryDate.description: Date on which this mandate decision expires.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.description: Statutory or regulatory basis for this mandate decision.

previousDecision.title: Previous Decision
previousDecision.description: Prior mandate decision, forming the supersession chain.

mandate.title: Mandaat
mandate.description: Individual mandate granting authority to a role.

mandateDecision.title: Mandate Decision
mandateDecision.description: Reference to the mandate decision that issued this mandate.

competenceType.title: Authority Type
competenceType.description: Type classification of the authority granted by this mandate.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.description: Statutory or regulatory basis for this mandate.

terms.title: Conditions
terms.description: Conditions including plafond (cents), subdelegatie flag, decisionTypes scope

subdelegatie.title: Sub-mandate Permitted
subdelegatie.description: Whether delegation to a lower level is permitted.

decisionTypes.title: Decision Types
decisionTypes.description: Decision types for which this mandate applies.

caseTypes.title: Case Types
caseTypes.description: Case types for which this mandate applies.

caseTypeGroups.title: Case Type Groups
caseTypeGroups.description: Groups of case types for which this mandate applies. A samenwerkingsverband names the group once instead of its thirty types, and a type that joins the group later is covered without a second act. Inheritance is OpenRegister's; dossiq does not re-apply the grant per type.

confidentialityLevels.title: Confidentiality Levels
confidentialityLevels.description: The confidentiality levels this mandate applies at. An AXIS of the declaration, never a role name: folding the level into the role gives a role per level per department, which is the combinatorial explosion every mandate matrix eventually becomes. Empty means every level.

validUntil.title: Valid until
validUntil.description: End date of mandate validity (null = open-ended).

status.title: Status
status.description: Current lifecycle status of this mandate.

organisatieRol.title: Organisatie Rol
organisatieRol._note: Without this OpenRegister leaves `@self.name` unset and `ObjectEntity` answers the uuid, so the Team picker listed uuids and the Team facet bucket read `3c26f5c4…` instead of `Team Permits`. The fallback OpenRegister applies when no field is configured tries `naam`, `name`, `title`, `label`, `titel`, and this schema has none of them. `roleName` is the property the Team COLUMN already extends the reference to read, so naming rows by it makes the three surfaces agree. It is `required`, so the name can never resolve empty. NOTE: `@self.name` is denormalised at SAVE time, so rows written before this landed keep their uuid until they are written again.

roleName.title: Role Name
roleName.description: Human-readable name of this organisational role.

roleType.title: Role type
roleType.description: Type classification of this organisational role.

department.title: Department
department.description: Department to which this role belongs.

team.title: Team
team.description: Team to which this role belongs.

mandateLevel.title: Mandate Level
mandateLevel.description: Numeric tier: used for next-higher resolution

medewerkerRolToewijzing.title: Medewerker Rol Toewijzing
medewerkerRolToewijzing.description: Assignment of a user (Nextcloud user id) to an OrganisatieRol over a validity window.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: Nextcloud user id of the employee being assigned.

roleId.title: Role ID
roleId.description: Reference to the OrganisatieRol being assigned.

allocationType.title: Assignment Type
allocationType.description: Type classification of this role assignment.

validFrom.title: Valid from
validFrom.description: Start date of the role assignment validity.

validUntil.title: Valid until
validUntil.description: End date of the role assignment validity (null = open-ended).

observerFor.title: Substitute For
observerFor.description: When toewijzingType=waarnemer, the userId being substituted for

caseTypeGroup.title: Case Type Group
caseTypeGroup.description: A group of case types granted as one. A gemeenschappelijke regeling has thirty case types belonging to one partner, and granting per type means thirty grants that drift apart. The group is the unit of the grant; a type inherits from its group, and the inheritance is OpenRegister's rbac-inherits-to-children rather than a rule dossiq re-applies.
caseTypeGroup._note: objectNameField is set for the same reason organisatieRol sets one: without it OpenRegister leaves `@self.name` unset, ObjectEntity answers the uuid, and the picker on a case type lists uuids while the facet bucket reads `3c26f5c4…`. The fallback tries `naam`, `name`, `title`, `label`, `titel`, and this schema has none of them. `@self.name` is denormalised at SAVE time, so rows written before this landed keep their uuid until they are written again.

groupName.title: Group Name
groupName.description: Human-readable name of this group of case types.

description.title: Description
description.description: What this group is for, and who it belongs to.

partner.title: Partner
partner.description: The samenwerkingsverband or partner organisation the group belongs to.

caseTypes.title: Case Types
caseTypes.description: The case types in this group. A type also carries the group on itself, which is the side the grant reads; this list is the authoring convenience.

mandateUsage.title: Mandaat Gebruik
mandateUsage.description: Immutable audit log of a mandate use (when a user executed a decision under a mandate).

caseId.title: Case ID
caseId.description: Reference to the case for which the mandate was exercised.

decisionId.title: Decision ID
decisionId.description: Reference to the decision taken under this mandate.

mandateId.title: Mandate ID
mandateId.description: Identifier of the mandate that was used.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: Nextcloud user id of the employee who exercised the mandate.

moment.title: Timestamp
moment.description: Date and time at which the mandate was exercised.

roleOnMomentFromDecision.title: Role At Decision Time
roleOnMomentFromDecision.description: Snapshot of the user's role at decision time

usedTerms.title: Applied Conditions
usedTerms.description: Snapshot of the mandaat voorwaarden used

mandateVersionId.title: Mandate Version ID
mandateVersionId.description: Version of the mandate actually applied

mandateEscalation.title: Mandaat Escalatie
mandateEscalation.description: Open escalation to a higher mandate holder.

caseId.title: Case ID
caseId.description: Reference to the case that triggered this escalation.

decisionType.title: Decision type
decisionType.description: Type of decision that requires escalation.

initiatorId.title: Initiator ID
initiatorId.description: User id of the employee who initiated the escalation.

targetMandateId.title: Target Mandate ID
targetMandateId.description: Reference to the higher mandate to which this escalation is directed.

targetUserId.title: Target User ID
targetUserId.description: User id of the higher mandate holder to whom this escalation is directed.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current lifecycle status of this escalation.

rejectedReason.title: Rejection Reason
rejectedReason.description: Reason provided when the escalation was rejected.

createdAt.title: Created At
createdAt.description: Date and time at which this escalation was created.

resolvedAt.title: Resolved At
resolvedAt.description: Date and time at which this escalation was resolved.
